newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica DBSA in 316mln rand Mpumalanga development.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica DBSA in 316mln rand Mpumalanga development.

text.p: South Africa's Development Bank of Southern Africa (DBSA) said on Friday it would commit a minimum of 316 million rand ($67.4 million) for infrastructure development to the Mpumalanga province, north of the country.
The bank said in a statement the focus of the financial support would be on rural infrastructure for agricultural purposes and electrification.
It would also be directed towards bulk water supply, electricity generation infrastructure and municipal infrastructure.
The allocation excluded the 200 million rand approved in principle for the Witbank to Maputo toll road in a co-financing arrangement with the private sector, DBSA said.
